description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter-based mobile app for a food delivery platform. It sets up the app's structure including routing, bottom navigation bar, and theme integration.

classes.name: SeamlessFoodDeliveryApp
classes.description: The root widget of the app, setting up MaterialApp, routes, theme, and bottom navigation.

classes.name: _SeamlessFoodDeliveryAppState
classes.description: The state class managing the bottom navigation index and widget display.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the SeamlessFoodDeliveryApp widget.

methods.name: _onItemTapped
methods.description: Updates the selected index for the bottom navigation bar and rebuilds the widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the material app with routing, theme, and bottom navigation scaffold.
